measurement.name: Pacific South Equatorial Countercurrent
measurement.range_interpretation: Historical local source range across cruise-study context. Endpoint occupations, statistical uncertainty and annual extrema unresolved; no midpoint selected.
measurement.geographic_scope: 170 E meridional sections, geostrophic SECC near 10 S. Excludes South Tropical Countercurrent south of 15 S and the subsurface/equatorial Cromwell extensions.
measurement.section_orientation: Meridional source sections; no independently reconstructed edges or flow-normal correction.
measurement.layer: Author geostrophic-current envelope with broad vertical support; exact width depth and reference level unresolved. Speeds above 10 cm/s generally within upper 300 m is a separate statement, not a 0–300 m width slab.
measurement.time_convention: November 1965–May 1968 Bora/Cyclone cruise-study context. No individual dates assigned to width range endpoints; not seasonal climatology or annual extrema.
measurement.boundary_rule: Author-reported geostrophic current width; exact velocity cutoff, paired lateral coordinates and reference level not specified in the inspected descriptor. Direct equatorial meters referenced to 500 m are a different method.
measurement.source_citation: Rotschi, H., Hisard, Ph. and Jarrige, F. (1972), The Water Masses of the Western Pacific at 170 E, between 20 S and 4 N, Survey Paper No. 15, Horace Lamb Centre / ORSTOM, advanced English adaptation. Preface dated 10 May 1972.
measurement.source_locator: Current discussion printed p10 / PDF13; cruise context printed pp3–4 / PDF6–7; method distinction printed p6 / PDF9; title/preface PDF1–2.
measurement.extraction_method: Range transcribed from visually reviewed original prose. No source figure or velocity boundaries digitized.
